FeedIntegritySnapshot.description: Counts source messages, never estimates how many executed trades were lost.

anomalies.description: Source-ID anomalies and interruptions with unknown loss.

missing_messages.description: Source IDs skipped on forward arrivals, not lost executions.

unknown_loss.description: Interruptions whose missing-message count is unknown, never known zero.

ReceivedExclusionsSnapshot.description: Received rows excluded before they could enter the usable tape.

counts_are_lower_bounds.description: True if either count is saturated and therefore only a lower bound.

malformed_rows.description: Rows that could not be mapped into a valid trade.

stale_rows.description: Non-overlap rows behind the accepted market-time watermark.

TabFeedDeliverySnapshot.description: A zero observation never certifies a complete source stream.

completeness_proven.description: Always false: these observations cannot prove completeness.

received_exclusions.description: Absent when this attachment cannot report received-row exclusions.

source_counts_are_lower_bounds.description: True when any source counter has reached its saturating bound.

description: Independently versioned observations of received-row delivery.

tabs.description: One cumulative record per open market tab.

title: FeedDeliverySnapshot
